videos.description: Discover revolutionary haircare formulas from Tweak'd using luxurious ingredients from around the world, including kauri amber resin from New Zealand, dhatelo oil from Nepal, and more.

videos.title: Saturday Morning Gift Show
videos.description: Saturday Morning Gifts is your ticket to shop right from home. So, tune in every Saturday morning for great gifts for one and all, only on QVC.

videos.title: QVC Garden
videos.description: Let QVC help you make the most of your garden this summer with a variety of products designed to take the stress and hard work out of those traditionally mundane garden chores.

videos.title: Molton Brown Indulgent Gifts
videos.description: Treat friends and family to a little indulgent luxury with fragrance experts Molton Brown. Find the perfect gift sets from London's bath, body and beauty connoisseurs.

videos.title: Kim and Co.
videos.description: Join designer Kim Mendelsohn as she presents her latest lines. Daytime chic to evening sophistication, weekend comfort to party glamour; the Kim & Co collection is designed for every aspect of life.

videos.title: Beauty Gift Ideas with Tweak'd
videos.description: Get some gifting inspiration from the beauty experts at Tweak'd. Tweak'd offer innovative, plant-based treatments for your hair and body to help you feel refreshed and revitalised from top-to-toe.
